subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 3: Story – The green yo-yo + Sound d
outcomes: I can follow the story The green yo-yo.
I can say doll, plane, train and yo-yo.
I know sharing is good. I can hear the d sound.

tf.why: Yes! Train is a new toy word.

tf.s: The story is about sharing toys.
At the end, the children all play together.
tf.why: Yes! They say: Let's all play!
Well done! When we share, we all play.

tf.s: Dig starts with the d sound.
I'm not sharing. is a kind thing to say.
tf.why: Let's share! is kind. I'm not sharing makes friends sad.

tf.s: Lion starts with the d sound.
tf.why: Lion starts with l. Duck starts with d.

tf.s: d – o – t makes the word dig.
tf.why: d-o-t makes dot. d-i-g makes dig.

tf.s: In the story, the yo-yo is red.
tf.why: The story is The green yo-yo.

tf.s: Duck and doll start with different letters.
tf.why: Duck and doll both start with d.

boxes.why: Jack's favourite toy is his plane.

d – a – d. What's the word?

boxes.why: A plane flies in the sky.

boxes.q: What do they say at the end?
boxes.why: They say Yes! Let's all play!
